subject: How about an indication if uploaded file is too large?

messages.author: b55e91b47a07d232
messages.subject: How about an indication if uploaded file is too large?
parts:
I just spent several hours trying to figure out why my app did not react when I uploaded a file. I eventually realized that the file exceeded the default max size. To quote from the relevant tutorial: 

    • By default, Shiny limits file uploads to 5MB per file. You can modify this limit by using the shiny.maxRequestSize option. For example, adding options(shiny.maxRequestSize=30*1024^2) to the top of server.R would increase the limit to 30MB.

Unfortunately the behavior seems to be to not react at all. For example, I had the following code:
rawData.trigger <- reactive({ 
            message( " ... rawData.trigger STARTING" )
            inFile <- input$rawDataFile 
                                 :
                                 :
          })
If the selected file exceeds the limit, my message never appears (i.e., the reactive function never gets invoked) so the problem is not readily identifiable, even though it is easily fixed. It would be a big help if Shiny could provide some sort of warning or error indication when this type of "user error" takes place. If this had been a deployed app being used by somebody else, they would be frustrated and I would be mystified.
